name: Within the Same Walls
source:
In the middle of Paris, two coffee shops exist within the same walls. One on each side of the veil between life and death. Aspiring author Magali discovers it by accident as she's working on her next novel...

[From [url=https://vithesixth.itch.io/within-the-same-walls]Itch.io[/url]]
